notes.title: Performance and Mud mats Update - Jan 16th 2022
notes.content:
Hello Lumberjacks!

This update brings the following changes to the game:
- Major performance improvement across the board: by disabling background rendering that was not used we got about 20% improvement in FPS ːsteamhappyː

- Mud mats releasing: main feature of mud mats are to slightly drop into the terrain once driven over for stability. It was not possible to retrieve them anymore once they have sunken. Now you can release them by dragging them out of mud with a winch.

- Old-style Tutorials levels are removed: most people should be able to start playing the Career mode right away since there are sufficient help icons scattered around that explain things. Also, players will get a free pickup and a small trailer from the get-go in Career.

- Open world levels locking: initially locked, open world levels now require players to play Career and reach some player level to unlock. Your existing save-games will load without this restriction. This is to guide players in the beginning to play Career at least a bit since there are more help-hints over there.

- Tuned game lighting settings for more dynamic/contrast, I guess it looks a bit better?

notes.title: Steam Workshop Launch - Game update Mar 01, 2021
notes.content:
This one is BIG, we got the Steam Workshop up and running! During the past months we have worked with a couple of dedicated modders to launch our first modded vehicles. Already more than a dozen vehicles/trailers are available to be played with in Career mode. Check them out, give feedback and remember to support the hard-working creators!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34757422/c84f4d0de365d4ea0cea49de1a8d64c32890538b.jpg

Next, we will continue to work with the mod creator community and bring more high quality modded vehicles to the Workshop in the coming months. Most of the work is still ahead of us. The support for custom maps will be in focus too, so stay tuned as we continue to bring all the features that the community needs.

In this update, we also managed to improve overall game quality in several areas:
- new type of job available in career mode - grind trees and deliver chips to chip plant
- active job panel visible at all times with the job details
- log length measurement tool on harverster and loader
- log career jobs allow partial deliveries for large jobs
- first person character physics fixes when handling logs or winch
- camera invert axis options in game settings
- sound volume fixes
- added vehicle handbrake/parking brake
- game day length in game settings adjustment
- vehicle texture cleanup/ consistency


and other smaller improvements.

notes.title: Career mode and much more - Game update Jan 22, 2021
notes.content:
Hello Lumberjacks! 

Can you believe, we are a bit more than 1 year in Early Access! We are super-proud of the progress we have made so far, yet it feels like we have just started. Could we have done more? Yes. Still, we believe that constantly adding value over time and listening to our audience will result in the best logging simulator out there.

This update brings the brand new Career mode to the game that brings the new level of challenge and will gradually grow in offering different goals to be completed. The Open world levels are still available in the game for players that will just want to enjoy the logging activities or play with mods.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34757422/bbc4ac0205936f4d0d390e0eafa78966dc3e6a56.jpg

So what is the Career mode? Idea is that You participate in the local Job market. Companies are present on the map and are seeking different kinds of services. Naturally most of them will be saw mills buying logs or pulp mills buying wood chips, but there are more ideas beyond that, such as wood product transportation between sites, production of different items, etc. You can bid on available jobs and try to deliver the required goods on time. Requirements include wood type, log length, etc. Some companies have their own delivery and will send their truck to Your logging yard. Yes, you have a logging yard now with a little cabin that can be entered, and access the job market through convenience of a laptop!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34757422/0a5ea6da841a172b0257beb2842b997afacdfce1.jpg

Because the log length is now a requirement, You can measure your chainsaw cuts with a tape measurement tool, while machines that cut to length - such as harvesters - will include the length measurement in their UI.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34757422/578056cd57ed6f625f7682b8ed95c03869af3858.jpg

Over time, You complete jobs on time and to the specification, You will 'level-up' towards bigger and better paying jobs, delivering more logs and longer loads, requiring more sophisticated machines to complete the work. In the near future, You will be able to expand your logging area, and eventually move to a bigger logging yard with more storage space and more facilities.

Now, a little bit about our plans in 2021. The 2020 was mainly focused on the graphics and controls, and we managed to reach our goals in terms of the look and feel of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34757422/ee5285b72bea6bea89307cae651c249f4a532a6d.jpg

The 2021 will be about the game mechanics itself, we will make the Career mode more complex and develop more activities to do on the map, including new vehicles, etc. The rough aim is to double the number of available vehicles in the game in 2021. Next to this, we will spend more time to bring up the modding capabilities and allow You to import custom vehicles and maps made by our modding community - hopefully bringing mods to Steam Workshop some time during 2021.

Hope that you all enjoy the update and happy logging!

notes.content:
This update brings the all new winch system! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34757422/20784c70c64f346c55229dd524c597631a9e413a.jpg

Attach to the trees, cut logs or other vehicles. Salvage trucks and trailers, climb uphill or skid logs by the cable. Available on the pickup truck, skidder and log hauler. To use the winch approach it from the first person, pickup the hook and attach manually. Vehicle controls allow you to tighten or loosen the cable, or to park the hook back to the vehicle.

[previewyoutube=_33nEVk_C1s;full][/previewyoutube]

Also included:
- visual upgrades to trees textures and terrain lighting
- motion blur post-processing (switchable via graphics settings)
- control response adjustments for snappier control of boom, cranes and articulated vehicles

and other smaller improvements. Enjoy!
